headline: Ethereum proxies verified (ABI source confirmed etherscan); implementation verification inferred not direct; multiple recognized-firm audits but GM-token and non-Ethereum contracts lack confirmed audit coverage and verification status

findings.text: OUSG proxy (0x1B19C19393e2d034D8Ff31ff34c81252FcBbee92) ABI is confirmed as sourced from etherscan (abiSource='etherscan') via DeFiPunkd surfacer, with implementation address resolved to 0x1CEB44b6E515aBf009E0CCb6ddaFD723886cf3Ff. The merged ABI covering both proxy and implementation functions was returned, which is consistent with implementation being verified on Etherscan, but direct fetch of the implementation page was blocked by Etherscan access restrictions — verification is inferred, not directly read. USDY proxy (0x96F6eF951840721AdBF46Ac996b59E0235CB985C) ABI fetch also blocked; implementation address not retrieved in this run. V1 status for non-Ethereum contracts (Mantle, BNB, Plume, Sei) not assessed — chain not supported by read API and Etherscan-family explorer fetches blocked.

Public source repos exist: ondoprotocol/usdy (confirmed via GitHub search) and ondoprotocol/rwa-internal (referenced in code4rena 2024-03 audit at commit 1fb114abde88c091bd264a92c8d65a0d37a78069). The OUSG and rOUSG contract names and structure visible in those repos correspond to the on-chain ABI shape (KYC registry, mint/burn roles, pause, upgradeable proxy pattern). No commit SHA pinned to currently deployed contracts was found in this run — this is a scope limit recorded here.

Ondo's official docs page (docs.ondo.finance/audits) lists extensive audit coverage: for Ondo Funds and USDY (Ethereum) — March 2025 Spearbit, February 2025 Halborn, April 2024 Code4rena, April 2024 Cyfrin, September 2023 Code4rena, August 2023 Zokyo, April 2023 NetherMind. For Ondo Global Markets (covering GM tokens, USDon, limit order contracts) — multiple 2025 audits by Spearbit, Cyfrin, FYEO, Cantina, Zellic. The most recent Ethereum USDY/OUSG audit is March 2025 Spearbit (~14 months before analysis date). Specific contracts in scope for each audit (e.g., whether new OUSG_InstantManager 0x93358db... is covered) could not be confirmed without opening PDFs.

Auditing firms for Ethereum USDY/OUSG include Spearbit (recognized), Halborn (recognized), Cyfrin (recognized), Code4rena (competitive audit platform, recognized). Ondo Global Markets audited by Cantina (Spearbit's platform, recognized), Zellic (recognized), FYEO. All firms on or within the recognized list. No unknown-firm-only audits.

The current OUSG_InstantManager (0x93358db73B6cd4b98D89c8F5f230E81a95c2643a) replaced a legacy address deprecated April 2025, suggesting deployment post-dates the April 2024 Code4rena audit. The February 2025 Halborn and March 2025 Spearbit audits are plausibly the ones covering this contract, but exact scope (which contracts/commits) could not be verified without reading those PDFs. GM token contracts (USDon, GMTokenManager, SyntheticSharesOracle, GMTokenLimitOrder) have multiple 2025 Cantina audits listed. Post-audit drift magnitude cannot be assessed without accessing audit PDFs — recorded as unknown.

OUSG proxy (0x1B19C19393e2d034D8Ff31ff34c81252FcBbee92) resolves to implementation 0x1CEB44b6E515aBf009E0CCb6ddaFD723886cf3Ff via DeFiPunkd crawl manifest. Implementation verification status inferred from merged ABI being available (standard etherscan proxy behavior) but not directly confirmed. USDY proxy implementation address not retrieved this run.

steelman.red: If OUSG and USDY implementation contracts turn out to be unverified on Etherscan (i.e., the merged ABI was served through a different mechanism), the protocol would have effectively unverified deployed logic for its core fund-custody token contracts.
steelman.orange: The implementation verification is inferred rather than directly confirmed; no commit SHA pins the current deployment to an audited codebase; the new OUSG_InstantManager's audit coverage is uncertain; and non-Ethereum contracts (Mantle, BNB, Plume, Sei) were not verified in this run — these gaps collectively justify orange.
steelman.green: Proxy ABI confirmed from etherscan source, public repos exist with matching contract structure, multiple recent audits from Spearbit/Halborn/Cyfrin/Cantina (all recognized firms), with the most recent Ethereum audit dated March 2025 — within 14 months of the analysis date.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because: while the OUSG proxy's ABI is confirmed as etherscan-sourced and recognized-firm audits exist through March 2025, the OUSG implementation verification is inferred not directly read, USDY implementation address was not retrieved, no deployment commit SHA was pinned, the newly active OUSG_InstantManager's audit scope is uncertain, and non-Ethereum chain contracts (Mantle, BNB, Plume, Sei) could not be assessed for verification — these gaps are consistent with orange (some main contracts verified, audit scope partially stale or uncertain for some deployed addresses).

evidence.shows: OUSG proxy on Ethereum: ABI source confirmed as 'etherscan', proxy resolves to implementation 0x1CEB44b6E515aBf009E0CCb6ddaFD723886cf3Ff, all merged view methods returned including KYC registry and role constants

Official Ondo audit page listing: for Ondo Funds and USDY (Ethereum) — March 2025 Spearbit, February 2025 Halborn, April 2024 Code4rena, April 2024 Cyfrin, September 2023 Code4rena, August 2023 Zokyo, April 2023 NetherMind; for Ondo Global Markets — multiple 2025 audits by Spearbit/Cantina/Zellic/Cyfrin/FYEO

Public source repository for USDY contracts; README confirms USDY and tokens use EIP-1967 TransparentUpgradeableProxy pattern with ProxyAdmin, and contracts include USDY, rUSDY, RWAHub, USDYManager, RWADynamicOracle — matching on-chain address book roles

Code4rena April 2024 audit context: OUSG contracts audited from ondoprotocol/rwa-internal at commit 1fb114abde88c091bd264a92c8d65a0d37a78069; scope includes ousgInstantManager.sol, rOUSG.sol, rOUSGFactory.sol
Code4rena September 2023 audit: USDY, rUSDY, RWADynamicOracle in scope; confirms USDY is TransparentUpgradeableProxy

protocol_metadata.about: Ondo Finance is an RWA tokenization protocol allowing whitelisted users to hold exposure to real-world assets through yield-bearing ERC-20 tokens. OUSG tracks a portfolio of short-term US Treasuries and is accessible to KYC-verified qualified purchasers, while USDY (US Dollar Yield) is a non-rebasing yield token backed by bank deposits and US Treasuries with broader eligibility. The protocol uses Transparent Upgradeable Proxies for its core token contracts and deploys across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Mantle, Polygon, Sei, Plume, and other chains via LayerZero bridging. Ondo Global Markets (GM) additionally offers tokenized equities and other assets through a synthetic-shares mechanism.
